findings.text: The integrity check imports unprotected `build-support/locked-nixpkgs.nix`, which can replace `pkgs.runCommand` or the judge's Python interpreter without changing any lock entry and thereby produce a passing verdict. Fix: protect this import and its dependencies, or define the package import directly in the protected judge file.

The lock now records source paths for individual parts, but ADR 0011 still describes per-system derivation paths that cover all dependencies and build commands. Fix: update ADR 0011 in this commit to describe the implemented lock and its coverage.
